toolsHeadline: Your tea business. Your next move.
toolsIntro: Compare teas for resale, understand your landed costs and build a practical plan for your first order—or your next one.
toolsPromise: Plan freely. Buy with clarity. No guaranteed earnings.
toolsAudienceTitle: Where are you in your tea business?
toolsNewBody: Start with the customer, then the tea. Test demand before committing to opening stock.
toolsRetailBody: Compare pack formats, public prices and the margin you need for your shelf.
toolsDistributorBody: Plan quantities, freight and customer credit. Confirm specifications and terms in writing.
toolsBrandBody: Consider tea, packaging, artwork and approvals together before a production commitment.
toolsRetailRisk: Finished packs simplify packing, but a discount alone does not establish a viable resale margin.
toolsBulkRisk: Bulk buying needs working capital, suitable storage and a plan for freight and credit risk.
toolsBrandRisk: Your brand brings packaging commitments, label responsibilities and customer acquisition costs.
toolsPlannerTitle: Make your next order part of a plan.
toolsPlannerIntro: A few decisions now. A more useful conversation about supply later. No phone number needed to explore.
toolsTimeline: When do you want to begin?
toolsPlanReady: Your next step is taking shape.
toolsUsePlan: Request a quote for this plan
toolsPlanNotice: This is your planning brief, not an approved stock proposal or confirmation of budget, serviceability or commercial terms. Refreshing resets your decisions.
toolsLocationNotice: A PIN helps describe your destination. It does not confirm delivery availability.
toolsCalculatorTitle: A good trade starts with the numbers.
toolsCalculatorIntro: Use a current catalogue pack and your own selling assumptions. Unknown costs stay pending. These calculations never set an order price.
toolsLoss: Expected revenue lost to discounts / bad debt (%)
toolsScenarioNotice: Each scenario keeps its own editable assumptions. Switching tabs does not invent demand or improve supplier discounts.
toolsPriceNotice: Catalogue snapshot for planning. Eligibility, stock, tax and final payable amounts are checked separately. Add only tax and costs not already included in the price. Negotiated trade rates require a written quote.
toolsPending: Complete the inputs to see your scenario. Enter 0 only for confirmed non-applicable costs.
toolsInvalid: Check highlighted inputs: use non-negative amounts with up to 2 decimals, whole pack counts and credit days, and 0–100 for losses. Monthly sales cannot exceed purchased packs in this single-order scenario.
toolsCash: Cash to plan before customer collections
toolsCreditNotice: Customer credit delays cash collection. Cash planning includes the full order and your reserve, assuming no supplier credit. It is not a complete cash-flow forecast.
toolsLossWarning: This scenario produces a loss. Review your price, landed cost, sales volume and customer terms before buying.
toolsMrpWarning: Your resale assumption exceeds the catalogue MRP reference. Check the actual printed label and permitted selling price before trading.
toolsMrpUnknown: No MRP reference is recorded for this pack. Confirm the printed label before choosing a resale price.
toolsUnavailableWarning: Your planned quantity exceeds current pack availability. Request a quotation; this calculation does not reserve stock.
toolsFreightWarning: Freight exceeds 20% of tea stock cost in your inputs. Compare order sizes and obtain a written freight quote.
toolsCompareTitle: A closer look at your shortlist.
toolsCompareHint: Select two or three teas to compare their recorded details. No tasting scores are inferred.
toolsCompareLimit: Compare up to three teas. Remove one to add another.
toolsCatalogueTitle: Choose the tea. Check the trade.
toolsCatalogueIntro: Real catalogue packs, current public prices and available formats. Evaluate the tea and its economics before adding stock.
toolsPublicPrice: Public pack price · trade terms separate
toolsProofTitle: Clarity you can check before you buy.
toolsProofBody: Start with the listed product, its pack details and a sample you can evaluate. Ask for the specification and commercial scope that matter to your order.
toolsQuoteChecklistBody: Product and grade, pack weight, MOQ, quantity, product cost, tax, freight, payment terms, lead time and the complaint process.
toolsRolesTitle: Supply is one part. Selling is yours to plan.
toolsRolesBody: Confirm TeaFloww’s agreed tea and packaging scope in your quote. You plan customer acquisition, storage, sales, payment collection and applicable business or label approvals. No exclusive territory or credit is implied.
toolsResourcesTitle: Useful work before your first sales visit.
toolsResourcesBody: Download a practical CSV template. Fill it with your own customers and observations; nothing here promises sales.
toolsRoadmapTitle: A preparation roadmap, at your pace.
toolsRoadmapIntro: Mark what you have done. These are suggested stages, not a promise to launch or earn in 30 days. Progress resets on refresh.
toolsStageOneBody: Choose your model, shortlist customers and confirm the approvals relevant to your operation.
toolsStageTwoBody: Evaluate samples consistently, record feedback and compare itemized landed costs.
toolsStageThreeBody: Agree product, quantity, packaging, payment and delivery terms before committing.
toolsStageFourBody: Track visits, collections and actual sales. Base your next order on evidence.
toolsFaqEmpty: No matching questions. Try another word or ask the trade desk.
toolsFaqMarginQ: Does a trade discount guarantee a resale profit?
toolsFaqMarginA: No. Include freight, delivery, retailer margin, losses, overhead and the selling price your market can support. A positive example is not guaranteed demand or income.
toolsFaqFreightQ: Can you confirm wholesale freight from my PIN?
toolsFaqFreightA: Use your PIN in the enquiry and request a written freight quote for the actual shipment. This page does not provide live wholesale carrier serviceability or rates. Retail shipping promotions do not establish wholesale terms.
toolsFaqPaymentQ: Which payment and credit terms apply?
toolsFaqPaymentA: Available retail payment methods and totals are checked at checkout. Wholesale payment, supplier credit or territory arrangements require written approval; none is automatically included.
toolsFaqSamplesQ: How should I choose a sample kit?
toolsFaqSamplesA: Check the kit’s current component weights, contents, availability and checkout price. Ask the team to resolve any title-versus-content discrepancy before ordering. A sample does not reserve a future batch.
toolsReview: Review your requirement before sending. Contact consent is required; future marketing is not included.
toolsQuoteProductHint: For example: product, SKU, packs or kilograms, grade and packaging
toolsFinalTitle: Your next step should fit your business.
toolsTeaShop: Serving prepared chai? Explore tea shops
